findings.evidence: repo prints <owner>/<repo> parsed from origin (https, git@github.com: and ssh://, optional .git or trailing slash); a non-github.com or unparsable origin exits 1 naming the URL
findings.fix: The model already parses those remote forms. Keep only the non-obvious part: on a non-github.com host repo exits 1 and the caller must set REPO=<host>/<owner>/<repo>. Move the URL-form list to references/ if a user asks for it, or record the deletion in docs/audit/recovery/pr-diagrams/record.md.

findings.evidence: The publish URL is the absolute form ... the absolute form and GHE are unverified: after the edit, open the PR and check that the image renders.
findings.fix: Keep the unverified-absolute-form warning, and add the non-obvious consequence: a private repo or GHE can show a broken image even when the blob URL is correct, so the check is part of publish success, not optional confirmation.

findings.evidence: Use when attaching or hosting a diagram image in a PR body, choosing where diagram images live, reusing diagrams in a promotion PR, finding related merged PRs, or reusing reviewers from merged source PRs
findings.fix: Render draw.io diagrams to PNGs with the diagram embedded, attach them to a pull request with gh --attach or, on GitHub Enterprise or gh older than 2.101, publish them to the single pr-diagrams branch, find the merged PRs a promotion should reuse, and collect those source PRs' human reviewers for the promotion. Use when attaching or hosting a diagram image in a PR body, choosing where diagram images live, reusing diagrams in a promotion PR, finding related merged PRs, or reusing reviewers from merged source PRs, even without the words "pr-diagrams" or "draw.io", including a request to create a per-PR image branch. Not for drawing a diagram of a module, creating a pull request, listing the reviewers already requested on a PR (gh pr view), converting a .drawio to a PNG for slides, or editing draw.io XML (draw-io).

findings.evidence: Loaded on demand by the explain-pr-changes command, and by the skill's SKILL.md for the two sections it names.
findings.fix: In SKILL.md Reference, name the two headings an agent must not load for the skill's own workflow, None-mode diagram filter and Body templates, next to the existing Do NOT load sentence, so the command-owned blocks are not pulled in with the two gated sections.

findings.evidence: On that warning take the branch route (publish) for that PNG instead of --attach.
findings.fix: State the default as one route for the whole body: if any rendered PNG warns that it is over 10 MB, publish every image for that PR through branch mode and do not mix --attach with publish URLs in the same body, unless the user explicitly asks to attach only the files under the limit.

findings.evidence: Twelve evals cover attach, render, related, reviewers, branch naming and recovery, but none assert the merge-commit stop in Promotion step 3 or the gh-and-origin repository mismatch that makes publish exit 2.
findings.fix: Add one eval whose prompt shows empty git rev-list --merges output and asserts the agent stops and asks for --reuse-from rather than reusing the related list, and one whose prompt shows publish exit 2 naming two different repositories and asserts no retry and no hand-built push.

findings.evidence: Should-not-trigger queries include draw a diagram, create a pull request, edit mxGraph XML, convert to a PNG for slides, explain the PR, add Mermaid to the README, list requested reviewers and push a feature branch.
findings.fix: Add near-misses that share the skill's objects but need a neighbor: comment an existing diagram image on a PR without attaching one, and request reviewers on a promotion PR without collecting them from its source PRs.

findings.evidence: A standalone caller sets these once; the explain-pr-changes command sets its own: AD, REPO, BASE, HEAD, TITLE.
findings.fix: Tell the standalone caller to set and export AD, REPO, BASE, HEAD and TITLE before any later step, and say that references/pr-body.md reads those names. Without them the branch-recovery and title-assembly blocks have unset variables.

findings.evidence: Loaded from SKILL.md without the command: ... and the $AD/state.env appends belong to the command; skip them.
findings.fix: Replace the command-only state.env sentences in the standalone path with the skill's own recovery: quote gh and publish stderr in the final message, and do not tell a standalone caller to continue to reviewers or append N to a file the skill never creates.
